# Frontend

React + TypeScript + Vite app for the Nearby Ambulances & Doctors project.
See the [root README](../README.md) for setup, scripts, and the API reference —
this workspace is normally run via `npm run dev` from the repo root.

```bash
npm run dev -w frontend    # Vite dev server
npm run build -w frontend  # type-check + production build
npm run test -w frontend   # Jest + React Testing Library
npm run lint -w frontend   # ESLint
```
